core_obligations: Identify the adjoint pair (proof lines 4322-4325): the restriction functor to the localized site is a right adjoint of extension by zero, which is exact.
Apply the criterion (proof line 4325): by the general result that a right adjoint of an exact functor preserves K-injective complexes, the restriction of a K-injective complex is K-injective.
proof_roadmap: Recall that restriction is right adjoint to the exact extension by zero.
Apply the general preservation criterion for K-injective complexes.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that restricting a K-injective complex of modules to a localized site yields a K-injective complex (statement lines 4313-4319). The proof names the two inputs: the general criterion that a right adjoint of an exact functor preserves K-injective complexes, and the fact that the restriction functor has the exact left adjoint given by extension by zero (proof lines 4322-4325). The author states that the result follows immediately from these and points to the discussion above for the adjunction. The claim is H2: a two-input reduction, with the inputs and the adjunction explicitly named.
